# {.center .title-page background-color="#1b1b3a"}

::: {.eyebrow}
Causal Map app | feature overview
:::


::: {.headline}
Causal Map [features]{.teal}
:::

::: {.subhead}
Everything you need to code, filter, and report causal claims across qualitative data.
:::

::: {.byline}
Steve Powell | Causal Map Ltd | hello@causalmap.app
:::

::: {.urls}
app.causalmap.app | garden.causalmap.app

## Human first, AI next {.callout-slide}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="32%"}
::: {.feature-icon-circle}
<i class="fa-solid fa-user-check" aria-hidden="true"></i>
:::
:::

::: {.column width="68%"}
::: {.feature-body}
Start by hand on a small sample to build your understanding. Then turn on [AI coding]{.hl-green} to scale to hundreds of documents, with human review and edit at every step.

*AI features need a separate subscription.*
:::
:::
::::

# Manual coding {background-color="#1b1b3a" .center .section-slide}

## [Highlight causal claims](https://garden.causalmap.app/create-link-tab/) {.feature-slide}

::: {.section-badge}
Manual coding
:::

:::: {.columns}

:::

Read your source text and [highlight]{.hl-yellow} phrases. Each highlight becomes a causal link between two factors.

::::

## [Full text search](https://garden.causalmap.app/full-text-search/) {.feature-slide}

::: {.section-badge}
Manual coding
:::

:::
:::

::::

Manual coding
:::

# AI coding {background-color="#1b1b3a" .center .section-slide}

## [One-click coding](https://garden.causalmap.app/simple-ai-runner/) {.feature-slide}

::: {.section-badge}
AI coding
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="32%"}
::: {.feature-icon-circle}
<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles" aria-hidden="true"></i>
:::
:::

::: {.column width="68%"}
::: {.feature-body}
Run the full pipeline ([auto-code, revise codebook, recode]{.hl-green}) in one go from a single set-up modal.

:::
:::
::::

## [Auto-code by paragraph](https://garden.causalmap.app/simple-ai-auto-code/) {.feature-slide}

::: {.section-badge}
AI coding
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="32%"}
::: {.feature-icon-circle}
<i class="fa-solid fa-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i>
:::
:::

::: {.column width="68%"}
::: {.feature-body}
AI reads each source and extracts causal links. Choose a [sample size]{.hl-yellow} (1, 5, 20%, 50%, 100%) and skip already-coded sources.

:::
:::
::::

## [Holistic first pass](https://garden.causalmap.app/simple-ai-auto-code-holistic/) {.feature-slide}

::: {.section-badge}
AI coding
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="32%"}
::: {.feature-icon-circle}
<i class="fa-solid fa-diagram-project" aria-hidden="true"></i>
:::
:::

::: {.column width="68%"}
::: {.feature-body}
Ask the model to draft a [whole-network diagram]{.hl-pink} first, then convert it to links. Reduces fragmentation on complex texts.

:::
:::
::::

AI coding

:::

::: {.feature-body}

:::
:::
::::

## [Recode](https://garden.causalmap.app/simple-ai-recode/) {.feature-slide}

::: {.section-badge}
AI coding
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="32%"}
::: {.feature-icon-circle}
<i class="fa-solid fa-arrows-rotate" aria-hidden="true"></i>
:::
:::

::: {.column width="68%"}
::: {.feature-body}
Map raw labels onto your codebook by [AI index matching]{.hl-yellow} or [embedding similarity]{.hl-pink}.
